description: Committed in 9952629. Vitest set up as devDep; test scripts `npm test` (run) and `npm test:watch` added. 27 tests across parseSvg.test.js (16) and fetchFont.test.js (11). Every LEARNINGS.md gotcha now has a regression guard: `{}` boundary in font-family regex, PSMT/MT/PS suffix stripping before weight-keyword lookup, WOFF2 magic-byte validation. Foundation for T-007 (CI). subsetFont.test.js deferred — fontkit interaction is harder to test in isolation and better covered by future integration tests.
title: Unit tests for parseSvg, fetchFont, subsetFont
